articles.title: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands
articles.read_scope: Complete main article, introduction through Conclusion and acknowledgements. Linked sources separately scoped; image pixels not inspected. No article code executed.

six_dimensions.trigger: Long-running work needs independent compute replacement, customer execution environments, and recoverable context.
six_dimensions.failure_constraint: One container couples session survival, harness availability, tool compute and credentials; provisioning delays even tasks needing no sandbox.
six_dimensions.mechanism: Separate an append-only session log, stateless orchestration and replaceable tool environments through stable interfaces; provision execution only when needed.
six_dimensions.limits: Service-specific latency results; durable history does not establish exactly-once external effects or indefinite artifact retention.
six_dimensions.counterexample: Analyst inference: replaying a logged tool request after an unrecorded successful remote effect can duplicate work.
six_dimensions.verification: Proposed distinct harness/sandbox/stream interruptions, resume from durable state, reconcile ambiguous effects, and compare latency/retention; not executed.

articles.title: Harness design for long-running application development
articles.read_scope: Complete main article and shown appendix, including frontend criteria, sprint contracts, both examples and component-ablation discussion. Embedded videos/images not played; code/examples not executed.

six_dimensions.trigger: Choose orchestration and evaluation scaffolding for a model/task combination or reassess it after a model upgrade.
six_dimensions.failure_constraint: Self-grading misses real interactions; indiscriminate simplification obscures which harness component contributes.
six_dimensions.mechanism: Calibrate an independent evaluator on concrete criteria, exercise the running product, and remove one harness component at a time on realistic tasks.
six_dimensions.limits: Few internal examples with changed feature scope and long expensive runs; no controlled general productivity guarantee.
six_dimensions.counterexample: A generator/evaluator pair sharing a blind spot can approve a nonworking core flow; more iterations need not improve human preference.
six_dimensions.verification: Proposed fixed prompt/model/environment comparisons with behavior checks, trace review, human calibration, cost and latency; not executed.

articles.title: Serverless servers: Efficient serverless Node.js with in-function concurrency
articles.read_scope: Complete main article from introduction through Acknowledgements, including architecture, efficiency example, beta tradeoffs, case study and enabling instructions. Diagrams interpreted from accompanying text only; runtime not executed.

six_dimensions.trigger: Interactive requests spend substantial time waiting on I/O while assigned compute sits idle.
six_dimensions.failure_constraint: Invocation-per-instance provisioning underutilizes compute; changing to shared execution changes process/global-state isolation.
six_dimensions.mechanism: An invocation service reuses connected instances for concurrent requests, with a runtime controlling dispatch and response streaming.
six_dimensions.limits: Benefits depend on traffic and I/O overlap; CPU-heavy work can worsen latency. Historical beta/cost claims are not current sizing guarantees.
six_dimensions.counterexample: Analyst inference: shared request-specific globals leak across tenants; larger concurrency exhausts a database pool before CPU capacity.
six_dimensions.verification: Proposed workload sweep measuring throughput, p99, CPU, memory, pool waits, downstream load and caller isolation; compare serial and concurrent execution. Not executed.

current_contract_crosschecks.title: Claude Managed Agents overview
current_contract_crosschecks.read_scope: Core concepts, How it works, Beta access
current_contract_crosschecks.supported_claim: Server-side event history can be fetched; managed API remains beta and requires its documented header. Historical architecture interfaces are conceptual, not literal current SDK method names.

current_contract_crosschecks.title: Session event stream
current_contract_crosschecks.read_scope: Resuming an idle session; custom-tool result correlation and session budget behavior inspected
current_contract_crosschecks.supported_claim: Conversation history persists until deletion, but sandbox state is preserved only 30 days after sandbox creation; activity does not extend this window. Required outputs must leave ephemeral execution state before expiry.

current_contract_crosschecks.title: Authenticate with vaults
current_contract_crosschecks.read_scope: Vault scope, credential types, session references, lifecycle
current_contract_crosschecks.supported_claim: Vaults are workspace-scoped and referenced per session; credential placeholders can be substituted at egress, MCP credentials match server URL. Binding the correct caller/vault still requires application authorization.

current_contract_crosschecks.title: Work with sessions
current_contract_crosschecks.supported_claim: SDK sessions persist conversation history, not the filesystem; forking history does not isolate shared file edits. Cross-host resume requires a session store/transcript transfer or explicit application artifacts.

current_contract_crosschecks.title: Fluid compute
current_contract_crosschecks.supported_claim: Current Fluid compute defaults differ from the 2024 beta: enabled for new projects since 2025-04-23; optimized concurrency supports Node.js/Python, and concurrent invocations share process/global state. Runtime general support list is broader than concurrency support.

claim_policy: Six-dimension cards distinguish reported mechanism from analyst inference and proposed verification. Publication reports are historical; current platform contracts have separate sources.
